name: Chat with Santa
tagline: A small seasonal chat app for families during the holidays.
shortDescription: A seasonal chat app with a child-friendly Santa experience and a simple family-first design.
longDescription: Chat with Santa is a seasonal experiment built around a simple idea: a friendly holiday conversation, without turning the experience into a noisy feed or game.
featureIntro: A focused holiday chat experience with warm replies and a simple interface.

features.title: Festive Chat Interface
features.body: A clean seasonal UI with a little personality and not much else in the way.

features.title: AI Santa Replies
features.body: Friendly responses written for warm, age-aware holiday conversations.

features.title: Voice and Text Input
features.body: Type or speak messages for a simple hands-free option.

features.title: Private and Secure
features.body: No advertising or tracking tools. Family trust is part of the design.

structuredData.description: A seasonal chat app with a child-friendly Santa experience and a simple family-first design.

privacySummary: Chat with Santa is designed to avoid analytics and advertising tracking, with conversations processed on-device.

seo.title: Chat with Santa | Seasonal Holiday App
seo.description: Chat with Santa is a simple seasonal holiday chat app for families with friendly Santa conversations.
